outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, then closes the gripper around it (frames 79–95, wrist_image). The drawer visibly slides outward during frames 98–118 (image and left_ego_image), exposing its interior. It remains open as the gripper releases and withdraws through frame 131 (image, left_ego_image and wrist_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visibly established.
